speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Delusional Disorder, Somatic Type (or Unspecified Schizophrenia Spectrum and Other Psychotic Disorder).

The patient presents with a fixed false belief regarding telepathic abilities lasting eight months, triggered by weather changes and unexplained by structural brain lesions or intoxication. Since there is no evidence of hallucinations or other psychotic features, this fits the criteria for delusional disorder.
